name: phantom-veil-pays-two-and-grants-the-linked-ally-stealth
notes: Phantom Veil's generated stealth body was fine, but no cost case existed for its (2) and it had no prereq: the ability was free and fired without a linked ally. ActivatedAbilityCost now queues two reserve payments; the prereq requires a linked ally.

rulesClauses: (2): Linked ally gains stealth until end of turn.

engineBug.summary: Phantom Veil's (2) cost was never charged.
